formation: Originally written as 𱖔, which depicts a knife with tooth-shaped decorations on the back. The components 彳 (walk) and 攵 (tap) were added later to indicate movement and action. Based on the original meaning "to punish". The meaning later shifted to "invade", "to summon" and "to recruit" while its other meaning used as a musical note is a phonetic loan.

components.note: 彳 is a component form of 行. Here used to indicate movement.
Depicts a knife with tooth-shaped decorations on the back.
攵 is a component form of 攴. Used here to indicate action.
